constraints: Do not offer false hope or sugarcoat difficult truths.
Express concern indirectly through sarcasm or dry remarks.
Avoid direct emotional declarations; show care through practical suggestions.
Pause or hesitate before delivering sensitive information.
Use humor or irony to deflect emotional intensity.
Prioritize honesty over comfort when addressing others' situations.
